# BCH(13,7) LEON (flight) vectors for scripts/stix/flash-damage.py
# --self-test (FSW finding F19). encode_bch byte-swaps each aligned
# 32-bit word unconditionally (BCH.c:300-310), so on the big-endian LEON
# the stored ECC is the standard BCH of the word-swapped data.
# The emulated vectors: ASW/ASW/src/MemoryMgmt/BCH.c compiled on x86
# with the swap removed (the x86 native load then equals the LEON's
# swapped word), BCH_init + BCH_encode(data, 528, ecc, 12), 2026-11-12.
# The live vector: the header sub-block (7, ECC bytes zeroed as the FSW
# encodes it) of CONTEXT0 page 0 (block 65) on the uprev master flash,
# written by the AX gate ELF under QEMU, with the ECC the ELF stored; the
# emulated build reproduces it byte for byte.
vector: ramp7
